reserves.issuerOrObligor: Undisclosed credit institutions and liquid-asset obligors

reserveReview.rationale: Retrieved issuer terms and whitepaper describe same-currency cash and high-quality liquid financial assets in segregated accounts. No dated itemized portfolio, bank identities or signed reserve-to-liability reconciliation was retrieved. The 100% slice denotes the entire unclassified book, not a measured allocation or backing ratio; the advertised 102% is an issuer assertion and receives no measured collateralization credit. Medium legacy risk records uncertainty in the unsplit basket rather than assuming Treasury-only backing.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-disclosed asset-class mandate; no measured current weights
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The whole reserve book lacks itemized assets, counterparty weights and a independently reconciled liability denominator.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: No public current cash/HQLA weights or tracked stablecoin exposure were established.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Whitepaper D.3 describes a distinct patrimony and the issuer says reserves are separate, not lent or commingled. Actual banks, account agreements, allocation, replacement mechanics and practical insolvency enforceability are not public in the retrieved material. The whole-book custody summary therefore remains unknown.
